data.fund_type: An open-ended equity scheme investing in ﬁnancial service sector
data.investment_objective: The primary objective of the scheme is to generate long-term capital appreciation from a portfolio that is invested predominantly in equity and equity related securities of companies engaged in ﬁnancial services. However, there is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and equity related securities of companies engaged in banking and ﬁnancial services sector: 80% to 100%, Equity and equity related securities of other companies: 0% to 20%, Debt and Money Market Instruments: 0% to 20%
data.benchmark: NIFTY Financial Services Total Return Index
data.fund_managers: FM1 - Mr. Alok Bahl; FM2 - Mr. Pratik Singh
data.exit_load: (i) If units redeemed or switched out are upto 10% (limit) of the units purchased or switched in within 3 months from the date of allotment – Nil (ii) If units redeemed or switched out are over and above the limit within 3 months from the date of allotment– 1% of the applicable NAV (iii) If redeemed/switched out after 3 months from the date of allotment – Nil
